text: The study does not show a preview effect at H = 0.5 x tau in the simulated turbine and oil damage (the no-knock reading) of the B58 model, which is not validated, on these roads (d = -6.28 points, two-sided 95 % t interval -12.01 to -0.56, against an MEI of 5.43 points). A null was the expected outcome (row 147 (7)) and says nothing against the criterion.

The sighted agents at r = 0.5 took more simulated turbine and oil damage (the no-knock reading) on the B58 model, which is not validated (its band assumed at b; section 12.1), than their blinded twins on these roads (d = -6.28 points, two-sided 95 % t interval -12.01 to -0.56, against an MEI of 5.43 points): a finding about this learner and recipe at this budget, never evidence that preview is worthless, and never read as a result about the criterion.
